task: Fix a native mobile form so software keyboard, permission denial, system Back, Dynamic Type or font scaling, and state restoration behave correctly.
starting_state: Form works at default text size but keyboard can cover actions and permission denial creates a dead end.
acceptance: Focused input remains visible with keyboard open
Back and restoration preserve user context
Scaled text does not hide critical actions
forbidden_outcomes: Treating the screen as a desktop layout merely stacked vertically
required_evidence: mobile runtime evidence or explicit BLOCKED platform checks

machine_checks.description: Keyboard does not cover primary action
